shortDescription: Install, upgrade, uninstall, and rollback IBM Storage Protect Server

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the lifecycle action to perform on the IBM Storage Protect Server.

options.name: force
options.description: Forces the requested operation even if pre-checks detect existing installations or version mismatches. Use with caution, especially during uninstall or rollback.

options.name: install_dir
options.description: Target directory where the IBM Storage Protect Server binaries should be installed. If not provided, the platform default installation path is used.

options.name: install_source
options.description: Path to the IBM Storage Protect Server installation media or extracted installer. Required when C(action=install) or C(action=upgrade).

options.name: log_file
options.description: Full path to a file where detailed execution logs should be written.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Logging verbosity for the module execution.

options.name: rollback_version
options.description: Version of IBM Storage Protect Server to roll back to. Used only when C(action=rollback).

options.name: version
options.description: Target version of IBM Storage Protect Server to install or upgrade to. Used for validation and idempotency checks.
